detail: Current Version12 source has no immutable12.4.3 publication identity. Link Audio existence, peer/Push firmware/directional capabilities and platform contexts remain unproven.

This retained chapter documents Link Start Stop Sync, not MIDI Start/Stop byte sequences, MIDI Clock Song/Pattern message policy or every port configuration. Do not transfer Link option semantics to MIDI wire behavior.

No MIDI preroll policy, calibrated lag, default Sync Delay/MTC Offset/Rate, numeric range/sign or frame list follows. The only explicit Control Bar visibility default is source009; generic lifecycle/boundary probes do not invent these values.

Real-time/reliable/perfect/clear-rhythm language supplies no algorithm, phase tolerance, tempo tracking error, acquisition/convergence time, packet loss or sample delay comparator. Peer count, name, status, buffer text and LEDs are not sync proof.
All caption text and literal image/link markup retained below, but no image pixels or external linked product catalog/FAQ/manual targets inspected; no hidden labels imported.

All cases remain proposals with independently admitted usable source/peer/nonzero-path/owned fixture and paired-positive guards. Malformed, loss, cancellation, undo, persistence, rate, arbitration and teardown remain broad unknowns; no unavailable feature/input passes a negative case.
